press.q: It's derby week against {opp}. What does this one mean to you?

answers.text: Everything. The fans deserve a win and we'll give them one.
Three points like any other. We stay calm.
They should be worried about us, not the other way round.

press.q: {opp} say they own this city. Your response?

answers.text: Talk is cheap. We'll answer on the pitch.
They can say what they like. I respect them.
Check the history books. This city is ours.

press.q: {opp} are favourites. Can {club} really get something?

answers.text: Absolutely. We fear nobody.
It's a tough test. A point would be a good result.
All the pressure is on them. We'll enjoy it.

press.q: How do you stop a side like {opp}?

answers.text: Work harder than them for ninety minutes.
I'm not giving my plan away in here.
We don't stop them. We make them stop us.

press.q: Three defeats in a row. Is your job under threat?

answers.text: I take full responsibility. We'll turn it around.
The players know they've let people down.
Bad luck, nothing more. The performances were fine.

press.q: Fans were booing at the final whistle. Do they have a point?

answers.text: They pay their money. They're entitled to show it.
We need them behind us, not against us.
Give us a few weeks. They'll be singing again.

press.q: How would you sum up the mood in the dressing room?

answers.text: Hungry. Everyone wants more.
Focused. We take it one game at a time.
Some players need to step up, and they know it.

press.q: Are you happy with the squad you have?

answers.text: Very. I wouldn't swap any of them.
We're always looking to improve.
Ask me again when the board give me money.

press.q: What are your targets for the rest of the season?

answers.text: Meet the board's brief, then see how far we can go.
Silverware. Nothing less.
Play football the fans are proud of.
